assay: bulk RNA-seq (Illumina HiSeq 2500), soleus, male C57BL/6J

condition: RL (10 d unloading + 3 d reloading with voluntary cage ambulation)

sample_inclusion: 36 soleus samples: YC 9, YU 4, YR 4, OC 9, OU 6, OR 4 (GEO); paper does not state RNA-seq n per group
primary_estimand: Effect of mechanical (un)loading / physical activity on soleus transcriptome within each age: disuse (UN vs CON) and early recovery after 3 d reloading (RL vs CON); the reloading step (RL vs UN) is the re-ambulation (activity resumption) effect. This is a disuse/reloading model, not an exercise-training intervention.
planned_contrasts: UN vs CON in adult (S2.4.p1, FIG4A)
RL vs CON in adult (S2.4.p1, FIG4A)
UN vs CON in old (S2.4.p1, FIG4A)
RL vs CON in old (S2.4.p1, FIG4A)
repeated_measure_unit: none; one soleus per independent mouse
normalization: Partek Genomics Suite 6.6 quantification on RefSeq transcripts (GEO data_processing)
paper_method: R package DESeq (original DESeq, not DESeq2) per GEO data_processing; supplementary methods (S1.8.p1) not available
paper_results: No DEG counts reported. KEGG (DAVID) oxidative phosphorylation, TCA cycle and fatty-acid pathways down with UN in both ages and further down with RL (FIG4A, S2.4.p1); Ppargc1a, Esrra, Esrrg mRNA decreased with UN and did not recover (qPCR, FIG4C); transcriptomic response similar in adult and old (S2.4.p2).
